_comment: Per-seed terminal census over one checkpoint, using the stage s own 1600-step
episode cap so that truncation means what it means in campaign metrics. Seeds are the
DECLARED-ORDER HEAD of the act1 promotion partition; campaign evaluation draws a deterministic
permutation of the same partition, so this sample and the campaign 500-episode gate sample
overlap but are not the same subset. The 25 winning seeds here are therefore additional
named victories, not a revision of the ledger counts.

promotion_gate.note: the gate is per-episode unconditional, so the conditional arrival rate is diagnostic, not a gate pass
